notes: The design lays its flanks out for a panel whose x runs along the car, as
the Tatuus does. On this car the door x runs up the car, so the names had
a quarter of a metre of length and shrank past reading, the hockey stick
had a box a third of the door long and stood up as a J, and the number
landed on the island the left fender shares with the door. These give the
stick the door, the board and number its upper middle between the handle
and the mirror and the team the space below, written for the left and
mirrored through the measured axes, since the right flank is the left one
